verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is HeyGen's enterprise API page, which lists "zero data retention options". If data is not retained, it cannot later be used for training, but the page never explicitly says customer data is excluded from model training, and the option appears only in the enterprise tier. missing for 10: an explicit no-training or opt-out policy statement, availability outside the enterprise tier, documentation of how to enable it, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
